## Classes

### `class ParticleNetworkPreferredDaemon`

Selects V3 only from a valid, pinned V2 advertisement. A valid advertisement with no V3 marker selects V2. Any V3 marker commits the connection attempt to V3; V3 integrity failures are forwarded and never retried as V2.
